crossRefs.note: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
My son, fear Yahweh and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious;

He said to them, “Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who…
subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.
I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks be made for all men:
for kings and all who are in high places, that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.
Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,
but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they…
Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.

translations.web: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme;
translations.bsb: Submit yourselves for the Lord’s sake to every human institution, whether to the king as the supreme authority,
translations.kjv: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;
